scripts.build:kernel-client: pnpm --filter @chariox/tool-display run build && pnpm --filter @chariox/kernel-client run build
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm run test:slice-provisioner && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run test
scripts.test:slice-provisioner: sh -c 'for file in apps/kernel/slice-linux-docker/provision-*.test.mjs apps/kernel/slice-linux-docker/slice-disk-quota*.test.mjs apps/kernel/slice-linux-docker/managed-rootless-quota*.test.mjs apps/kernel/slice-linux-docker/slice-screen-*.test.mjs; do [ -f "$file" ] || exit 1; done; exec node --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/kernel/slice-linux-docker/provision-*.test.mjs apps/kernel/slice-linux-docker/slice-disk-quota*.test.mjs apps/kernel/slice-linux-docker/managed-rootless-quota*.test.mjs apps/kernel/slice-linux-docker/slice-screen-*.test.mjs'
